fact_text: E-commerce platforms play a role in 30 to 40 percent of Pakistan's exports, according to the guest from the Pakistan E-commerce Association.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: The FY26 budget introduced new taxes and regulation for e-commerce platforms, covering their taxation and registration requirements.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: Under the FY26 budget, logistics companies were authorised to charge 2 percent on cash-on-delivery collections, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: Logistics companies were authorised to charge 1 percent on online payments made through the platforms, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: Payment gateways charge an additional 2 to 3 percent on transactions, according to the guest, on top of the logistics levies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: Cash-on-delivery money passes through logistics firms before reaching sellers' accounts, so a levy on those collections cuts sellers' cash inflow directly.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: The guest argued the new levies hit small sellers hardest, because they may have to give up margins and their customers' buying power falls.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: The FBR reportedly exempted sellers whose monthly business stays below a turnover threshold from the new e-commerce tax; the threshold figure is unclear in the transcript.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: Sellers on platforms such as Daraz need an NTN (national tax number) to register, and many small sellers already hold one for car or property purchases, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: More than 200 e-commerce online businesses are operating in Pakistan, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: More than 100 small sellers have begun selling on Amazon, eBay and other platforms, many after completing online courses, according to the guest.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)

fact_text: The association's Karachi chapter president said the group wants a table talk with government, where it will share a proposal and back actions it finds workable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Can Pakistan E-Commerce Survive the New Tax Wave? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-24)
